tools.name: search_catalog
tools.description:
Search Quantum Atlas UCP products including Stripe X402 prepaid spend packs and live 50/50 Base ERC-1155 collaboration drops. Use this first for keyword discovery; do not use for batch ID refresh (lookup_catalog) or single-item PDP detail (get_product).
Parameters: pass catalog.query, optional catal

tools.name: lookup_catalog
tools.description:
Batch-resolve and refresh live USD pricing and stock for up to 50 known product, variant, or drop IDs. Use this to re-price saved wishlists or carts; do not use for keyword search (search_catalog) or single-product option pickers (get_product).
Parameters: pass catalog.ids (1-50 IDs or URLs), option

tools.name: get_product
tools.description:
Fetch full Product Detail Page (PDP) metadata, feature bullets, media, and variant availability for one product or variant ID. Use this before cart creation when inspecting a single item; do not use for multi-ID refresh (lookup_catalog) or keyword search (search_catalog).
Parameters: pass catalog.id

tools.name: create_cart
tools.description:
Create a stateful UCP shopping cart with itemized USD cent totals and instant digital delivery estimates. Use this for low-commitment basket assembly; use create_checkout directly when ready to finalize purchase.
Parameters: pass cart.line_items (array of { item: { id }, quantity }), optional cart.c

tools.name: get_cart
tools.description:
Retrieve current line items, itemized USD cent totals, expiration timestamp, and resume URL for an existing UCP cart. Use this to inspect ucart_* basket state; do not use for checkout sessions (get_checkout).
Parameters: pass top-level id ("ucart_<20 hex chars>") returned by create_cart.
Behavior: r

tools.name: update_cart
tools.description:
Replace line items or buyer locality context on an active ucart_* shopping cart and recompute USD cent totals. Use this to adjust quantities or add/remove variants before converting to checkout; do not use on canceled carts.
Parameters: pass top-level id ("ucart_*") and cart.line_items (full-replace

tools.name: cancel_cart
tools.description:
Cancel and discard an active ucart_* shopping cart session so it can no longer be modified or converted into a checkout. Use this when a buyer abandons a basket; use cancel_checkout for uchk_* checkout sessions.
Parameters: pass top-level id ("ucart_*") and meta.idempotency-key.
Behavior: transition

tools.name: create_checkout
tools.description:
Create a uchk_* UCP checkout session either by converting an existing ucart_* cart or directly from buy-now line_items. Use this when transitioning from browsing/cart to purchase commitment; call complete_checkout next to generate the final payment handoff.
Parameters: pass checkout.cart_id (with ch

tools.name: get_checkout
tools.description:
Fetch current status, line items, final USD cent totals, fulfillment options, escalation messages, and continue_url for a uchk_* checkout session. Use this to poll or resume checkout state; use get_order for post-checkout order tracking.
Parameters: pass top-level id ("uchk_<20 hex chars>") returned

tools.name: update_checkout
tools.description:
Update line items, buyer contact/wallet details, or selected fulfillment options on an open uchk_* checkout session. Use this to supply buyer email or 0x wallet before calling complete_checkout; rejected once canceled or completed.
Parameters: pass top-level id ("uchk_*") and checkout object contain

tools.name: complete_checkout
tools.description:
Finalize pre-payment checkout validation, mint a live Stripe Checkout or 50/50 Base DropERC1155 checkout session, and return UCP status "requires_escalation" with continue_url. Use this to hand the buyer off to Merchant-of-Record payment authorization.
Parameters: pass top-level id ("uchk_*"), meta.

tools.name: cancel_checkout
tools.description:
Abort an open uchk_* UCP checkout session before payment settlement. Use this when the buyer declines or restarts checkout; cannot reverse an already-paid Stripe or on-chain Base USDC transaction.
Parameters: pass top-level id ("uchk_*") and meta.idempotency-key.
Behavior: transitions checkout statu

tools.name: get_order
tools.description:
Inspect post-checkout payment and fulfillment status for a Quantum Atlas UCP order ID (uord_*), uchk_* checkout ID, or 32-hex Stripe spend-pack order ID. Use this after buyer handoff to check whether payment completed.
Parameters: pass top-level id ("uord_*", "uchk_*", or 32-hex Stripe card order ID

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "update_checkout" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Update line items, buyer contact/wallet details, or selected fulfillment options on an open uchk_* checkout session. Use this to supply buyer email or 0x wallet…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "complete_checkout" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: lookup_catalog, get_cart, get_checkout, update_checkout, get_order · Private data: update_checkout, complete_checkout · Public sink: get_checkout, update_checkout, get_order · Destructive: lookup_catalog, get_product, update_cart.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: lookup_catalog, get_cart, get_checkout, update_checkout, get_order · Private data: update_checkout, complete_checkout · Public sink: get_checkout, update_checkout, get_order · Destructive: lookup_catalog, get_product, update_cart

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
